Leaflet + Leaflet.draw vendored locally (no runtime CDN).

Sources:
- leaflet-1.9.4: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/releases/tag/v1.9.4
- leaflet-draw-1.0.4: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.draw/releases/tag/v1.0.4
  (also tagged 1.0.4 on npm as leaflet-draw@1.0.4)

Note: map templates reference these via {% static %} only; no unpkg/cdnjs/jsdelivr
at runtime. Tile images are fetched from OpenStreetMap at runtime (see privacy
notice in templates); JS/CSS themselves are local.
